$comment: Test-only, host-neutral Git executable selection goldens. Not exported.
builders: inputs and outputs of the pure @canopy/protocol/git-executable helpers.
scenarios: whole-selection cases each host runner replays through its own filesystem and process seams.

filesystem kinds: missing, eacces (lookup fails with EACCES), directory, executable (stdout is what `--version` prints), shim (an Apple or Homebrew shim that must never run), symlink (resolves to target). Unlisted paths are missing.
developerDir: raw `xcode-select --print-path` stdout, or null when the command fails. whereExe: `where.exe <name>` stdout by name; an unlisted name fails.

attempts: the candidate paths the selection looked up, in order (Windows trims each candidate first). expected applies to every path-join flavor; expectedByJoin keys it by flavor when Windows candidate paths differ.
status.error: a string must match exactly, null must be absent, and an omitted field is not asserted.
Padded win32-flavor values use trailing whitespace: Node releases differ on prefixing .\ when a leading-space segment holds a colon.
arch (Linux only, default x64): any other value is a Linux target without login-shell discovery.
transient (executable only): "timeout" makes every run of that file time out without changing the file.
noexec: a regular file the user may not execute.

steps: later spawn resolutions against the same host state. filesystem patches the table, select is a validated user selection, elapsedMs advances only TTL clocks. resolved is the executable spawned, or null when resolution fails.

falls back to the system location for an empty PATH
treats a trailing-slash system directory as covering the system location

uses the injected Windows path flavor; a drive colon splits like any PATH separator

skips whitespace-only bases and joins padded bases untrimmed (win32)
skips whitespace-only bases and joins padded bases untrimmed (posix)
normalizes a trailing separator only in the win32 flavor
keeps a trailing backslash in the posix flavor
returns nothing when no base is set
